title: The Street Violin
summary: A shy girl plays the violin in the street to save money, and a stranger changes her plans.

cover.scene: Flat 2D illustration: Ama playing a violin on a busy city square, a few people stopping to listen, autumn leaves, no text

chapters.title: Playing for Strangers
sentences: Ama had played the violin since she was six years old.
She wanted to study music at a big school, but the fees were very high.
So every Saturday, she took her violin to the main square and played for the people passing by.
At first, she felt shy, and she closed her eyes while she played.
Most people walked past without stopping.
Some of them smiled, and a few left small coins in her case.
After a month, she had saved only a little money.
She began to doubt her dream.
One cold afternoon, she nearly stayed at home.
But she picked up her violin and went to the square anyway.

quiz.q: Why did Ama play in the square?
options: To save money for music school
quiz.explain: The school fees were high, so she wanted to save money.

quiz.q: How did Ama feel at first?
quiz.explain: She felt shy and closed her eyes while she played.

options: She had saved only a little money
quiz.explain: She had saved only a little money, so she began to doubt her dream.

chapters.title: An Unexpected Offer
sentences: That afternoon, an older man stopped and listened to her for a long time.
When she finished, he clapped and gave her his card.
"I am a teacher at the music school," he said. "You play beautifully."
Ama could not believe what she was hearing.
"I think you should try for a scholarship," he continued.
"Students who win it pay no fees."
She practised every evening for two months and trained hard for the test.
On the day of the test, her hands were shaking, but she played from her heart.
A week later, a letter came. It had good news.
Ama read it three times and then ran to tell her mother.

quiz.q: Who was the man in the square?
quiz.explain: He said he was a teacher at the music school.
He told her to try for a scholarship.

options: She won a prize in the square
quiz.explain: A letter arrived with the good news after her test.
